properties.description: The walkthrough: one made-up design, the Gearheads' climber, followed in eight steps. It goes from its first requirement through the questions, the options and the decision, into the code, and back: drift caught, a rule change's reach shown before the edit, a measured result pointing at the decisions it reaches. Each step is labelled with who does it (the people, their AI assistant, reflow2). It closes on the five decision steps and what a project with no code still gets. Hand-written; the footer says which release it was checked against.
properties.name: site/walkthrough.html — one project, start to finish
